newsitem.title: USA: AirWays to offer Des Moines-Orlando service.
newsitem.headline: AirWays to offer Des Moines-Orlando service.

text.p: AirWays Corp said Wednesday its AirTran Airways unit will offer flights between Des Moines International Airport and Orlando on March 6.
AirTran will market a special $79 one-way fare for customers travelling between March 6 and September 4. Tickets must be purchased by February 6, AirWays said.
The carrier will also launch service between the Quad Cities and Orlando on March 6.
Standard one-way fares will range in price from $99 to $199, the company said.
AirWays os the parent of AirTran Airways. Its shares were up 1/8 Wednesday at 4-5/8.
